Figure 4:Without the matching video, ECT waits.A mistake-free QICD test step under the original recording (top) and under another recording of the same recipe at the same frame indices (bottom); instruction and clock are unchanged.
ECT confirms the step on time in the original and 129 s late in the swap, without raising an alarm. Gray: the±\pm15 s tolerance around the step end.
The step is one of the seven nearest the median duration among the 28 test steps that seed 0 confirms on time and, after the swap, neither flags nor confirms within tolerance (SupplementH).

Figure S1:An early confirmation that ECT avoids.On this 44 s Ego-MC-Bench step, seed 0 of “+ clean” confirms at the first check, 5 s in, when stirring has just begun. All four seeds of ECT and seed 1 of “+ clean” confirm at 35 s, within tolerance. The example has the median duration among audited steps without an explicit duration in the instruction where ECT confirms on time and “+ clean” confirms early.
